text.description_html:
Laurey 57126, Transitional Newport 96mm Cabinet Pull in Polished Chrome

The Small Polished Chrome Newport Cabinet Pull has 96mm center to centers. The Transitional Newport 96mm Cabinet Pull in Polished Chrome comes packaged with mounting hardware. The 96mm Newport Pull Polished Chrome can be used as a kitchen cabinet pull or also in the bathroom or on furniture.

This transitional cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Newport Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 57126 96mm Pull Newport Polished Chrome:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Polished Chrome
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3.78" (96mm)
  • Overall Length: 4.61"
  • Width: 0.41"
  • Projection: 1.18"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
